surfaces.cell: Falsifiable Erdos-Graham inequality: lcm(1..p_{k+1}-1) < p_k * lcm(1..p_k) for all k >= 1; record = largest X with the inequality verified for all k with p_{k+1} <= X

external_movement.summary: RajveerKapoor/erdos-work (papers/erdos-458, 2026-08-14) claims the inequality holds for all p_{k+1} <= 1.10889e27, against the atlas L of 1e12. This is reported and not verified by the sweep. The same reduction is noted independently in the-omega-institute/trureturing#9524 (2026-09-23), and #458 remains falsifiable upstream.
